Key Changes / Processing Steps: Trained a baseline image classifier to predict the exact name of the dish from 25 categories.
Observations: Accuracy was good initially, though visual ambiguity (like rice and meat variations) caused some confusion between classes.

Batch Size & Epochs: Batch Size: 32, Epochs: max 40 (Early stopping patience 7)
Key Changes / Processing Steps: Restructured the dataset into 'veg' and 'non_veg' categories to simplify the task. Switched to EfficientNet-B2 for better feature extraction. Added Label Smoothing (0.1).
Observations: Significant accuracy jump. Model proved that learning high-level dietary features is much easier than exact dish names.

Key Changes / Processing Steps: Fine-tuned the Arabic model on a new German dataset. Introduced YOLOv8 segmentation to crop out backgrounds/plates before classification.
Observations: Segmentation dramatically removed background noise, pushing accuracy to ~95.5%. Proved transfer learning between cuisines works.

Key Changes / Processing Steps: Tested the final German-tuned model on unseen real-world Arabic dishes. Images were grouped by dish and mapped to veg/non_veg labels.
Observations: Model struggles specifically with visually ambiguous dishes (e.g., golden-brown cheese pastries looking like meat pies, or rice dominating meat).
